# ^#E2C344;Firing & Recoil^reset;
Project 45 guns fire like any other gun, except they have a relatively predictable recoil.

When firing, your gun's muzzle will kick up, and you will have to adjust your aim downward to counteract the recoil.

Take a moment to steady your aim; ^#D93A3A;projectile direction is based on the angle of your gun^reset;.

# ^#E2C344;Gun Modding^reset;
If a mod cannot be installed on a weapon, it will be indicated the next time you hold your weapon via red text that appears above the player character's head.

# ^#E2C344;Gun Modding^reset;
Modding weapons is similar to installing augments on EPPs. Whether you can install a mod on a weapon or not is largely dependent on their ^#d29ce7;Categories^reset;, ^#95d1f3;Upgrade Capacity^reset; and associated ^#9da8af;Mod Slots^reset;. For ammo mods, their ^#EA9931;Archetype^reset; also matters.

# ^#E2C344;Introduction^reset;
Project 45 guns are different from vanilla guns in the following aspects:
1. They have the ability to ^#D93A3A;crit^reset; (and supercrit beyond 100% chance).
2. They are more ^#51BD3B;energy-efficient^reset; due to being ammo-based.
3. They are ^#d29ce7;modifiable and upgradable^reset; on the fly.
4. Some fire different kinds of projectiles.
5. Most can be converted to fire other kinds of projectiles.

# ^#E2C344;Misc Stats^reset;
These stats are not necessarily shown in the weapon's tooltip, but affect the weapon's performance nonetheless.
^#96cbe7;- Multishot^reset;: Multiplier to the number of projectiles a weapon fires. Decimals are treated as odds that the gun fires an additional set of projectiles.
^#f4988c;- Heavy^reset;: Forces the wielder to walk while holding the weapon.
^#f4988c;- Recoil^reset;: Multiplier to the kick-up angle (and maximum recoil angle) of the gun when firing.

# ^#E2C344;Misc Stats^reset;
^#f4988c;- Inaccuracy^reset;: Random movement of the arm as the weapon fires.
^#f4988c;- Spread^reset;: Natural deviation of bullets from their trajectory.
^#9da8af;- Trigger Time^reset;: Amount of time it takes before registering the next click. A factor of overall ^#E2C344;fire time^reset;.

# ^#E2C344;Stat Bonuses^reset;
Weapons spawn with a seeded stat ^#96cbe7;bonus ratio^reset;.

The weapons can have
- up to a ^#ea9931;+12%^reset; bonus to their base damage,
- up to a ^#f4988c;+20%^reset; bonus to their base critical chance, and
- up to a ^#d93a3a;+6%^reset; bonus to their base critical damage multiplier.

# ^#E2C344;The Supply Transponder^reset;
^#eab3db;The Supply Transponder^reset; provides a relatively affordable way to obtain various Project 45 items. This item has the following odds for calling in:
- a ^#96cbe7;50%^reset; chance to drop a ^#96cbe7;Common or Rare Supply Drop (R)^reset;,
- a ^#cb44ff;46%^reset; chance to drop a ^#cb44ff;Rare or higher rarity Supply Drop (SR)^reset;,
- a ^#ffffa7;2%^reset; chance to drop an ^#ffffa7;Essential Supply Drop (SSR)^reset;, and
- a ^#f4988c;2%^reset; chance to drop ^#f4988c;Unique Essential Supply Drop (XSSR)^reset;.

# ^#E2C344;Weapon Stats^reset;
^#95d1f3;- Upgrade Capacity^reset;: The number of Stat Mods you can install on the weapon.
^#EA9931;- Damage per Shot^reset;: The range of damage a gun's (initial) projectiles will deal at 100% power multiplier, disregarding the target's defense.
^#E2C344;- Fire Time^reset;: the overall time it takes for the gun to fire a round.
^#51BD3B;- Reload Cost^reset;: the total percentage of energy required to reload a gun to its full capacity.

# ^#E2C344;Weapon Stats^reset;
^#cccccc;- Reload Time^reset;: the maximum possible amount of time it takes to reload a gun to its full capacity.
^#D93A3A;- Crit Chance^reset;: the chance of the gun dealing increased damage. Odds beyond 100% give shots a chance to deal even more damage (i.e. a "Supercrit").
^#D93A3A;- Crit Damage^reset;: the number multiplied to the projectile's damage when it deals a super/crit.

A heavy-handed silence pressed against her as she gauged the distance: around 80 meters, approaching fast. Normally, this type of task was meant for someone like Sen, and she knew as much. But even so, that wouldn't stop her. It never had: she was a Titan first, and a Soldier second.

She smirked. 50 meters. "Cover! Now!" She didn't have to yell twice as their formation tightened before her sentence had even finished. 20 meters. Her shield held steady, and her fingers wrapped tightly around the pistol in her hand. There would only be a few seconds, but she would make those seconds count. 1 meter. A screeching sound rang as the bolt slammed against metal, nearly breaking their guard. Nearly. But a Titan's shield, albeit lighter than a Paladin's, wasn't just for show. The blast deflected, slamming the ground with a force that staggered the two besides her. But without a word, her hand moved from defensive to offensive, and as the shots rang out, victory was decided.

A pop. His gaze did not waver, nor did he flinch. His body unmoving and his breath steady, he slowly backed up. A 'black eye' turned to look at him as a piece of flesh sopped down from its 'jaw'. Plop. The disgusting, bloody mess hit the floor, scattering little red droplets in every direction: one nearly stained the pristine sheen of his adorned boots, but a flash of light boiled it before it could. The 'creature' recoiled, seemingly irritated by the flash. He took this brief moment of 'shock' as a blessing, and slammed a heavy metal grate -- one normally operated electrically -- shut with one hand. An alarm stuttered, as if stifled by something sinsister, attempting to warn the crew of immenent hull collapse. A bit too late... Just a bit too late.

There was no longer a crew.

Unlike many other militaries around the globe, Japanese used many rifle cartridges at the same time - 7.7, 7.7 semi-rimmed, 6.5, 6.5 with a special powder load... A smaller update but one which we welcome Ven as a coder, that made some of this possible, especially the hunter and battlemage stuff.

Compatibility:
    Small compatibility fix concerning alchemists and Futaradragons.

Mechanics:
    Stat scaling is now increased if you play Classic Mode. This is to help make Classic Mode actually worth considering rather than simply turning on consequences for no gain.

    Hunter: Crouching now recharges the camoflague and allows them to remain hidden indefinitely. However, the duration when moving has been reduced from 5 seconds to 3 to compensate for this.

Is it a robot? Yes? Wrench.

Is it a vehicle? Yes? Wrench.

Is it a biological horror fused to a mechanical exosuit, attempting visciously to claw through your suit and squeeze out your innards? Yes? Wrench.

Amidst the trees she waited, bow in hand, searching for a sound. When one graced her ear, her mind turned instantly, forming connections. Almost immediately, she knew where it was and what it was, and before it had even ended, a quiet 'thwip' erased it... Another meal.

Beneath the murky clouds, she took residence in a nearby delapidated bunker: essentially ruins at this point. But it gave her cover from the howling winds, pounding rain into the metal. She heard every drop. Flames lighting up the darkness, with occasional flashes from lightning outside, she cooked the beast, salivating. Another night.

Morning came and she woke calmly, nudged gently by someone familiar. Normally, she would have noticed a presence much sooner, knife brandished, but with the Floran in front of her, it was rather difficult. The Floran smirked, before offering up a canteen. The nectarine water relieved her parched throat. Another morning.

The two continued along a tangled path, relying on her ears and eyes for guidance. Approaching the unknown entrance, they stopped to investigate - and summarily dismantle - the various contraptions meant to brutally dismember intruders. With the two of them quite astute and dextrous, it was child's play. The Ancient Tomb now exposed forever, the two searched inside, longing for an answer. Despite the Floran's perfect translations, the text was seemingly nonsensical, but not quite. Another clue.

Now back in vicious wilderness, the two took shelter once more. Despite the situation, the Floran's hand grazed her neck. "Will you help me recharge?" The Floran teased: her actions set the context. "Ha!" The Hunter giggled. "That's just like you. All alone for only three days and you're already like this." Even so, she reciprocated: Hunter or not, a little levity never hurt. Another day... a peaceful day.

An upgrade to Bash. While sprinting, the player receives physical resistance. While damage remains the same, enemies are stunned on hit. Damage scales with Strength and Run Speed. Energy Cost decreases with higher Agility.

An upgrade to Controlled Hover: while hovering, a Nova Barrier grants you +20% Physical Resistance and strips the ^red;Burning^reset;, ^yellow;Electrified^reset;, and ^blue;Frost Slow^reset; Statuses. Taking damage while this is active fires Nova waves towards the source of the damage. ^magenta;Additionally^reset;, press [Special 3] while aerial to leave a Nova Platform beneath you that slowly drifts downwards: while active, the platform drips an unstable liquid that causes Starfall.

An upgrade to Double Jump, double-tap down while midair to slam downwards. You take no fall damage upon landing, and cause a small explosion, damaging enemies. Damage scales with Strength and distance fallen from activation.
An upgrade to Double Jump, hold up to glide forward, slowly losing altitude. You can use your double jump while gliding. Glide energy cost decreases with higher Agility.

An upgrade to Double Jump, jump while aerial to launch yourself in a direction of your choosing, leaving a cloud of smoke behind that disorients enemies. Disoriented enemies are slowed and do less damage. Defaults to a backwards launch.

An upgrade to Double Jump, press jump while aerial to dash. You can dash in all cardinal directions, as well as change direction mid-dash. Unless [Shift] is held, default direction is upwards. Dash Duration scales with Agility. You can dash twice in mid-air.

An upgrade to Double Jump. Trying to jump while holding [Shift] fires a cannonball towards your cursor that pierces enemies and explodes on impact with blocks. While aerial, jumping without holding [Shift] sends the cannonball flying downwards, in the opposite direction of your held horizontal movement key, allowing you to launch yourself twice. Damage scales with Dexterity. ^red;Grounded Fire Cooldown: 2.5 Seconds. Aerial Fire Cooldown: 0.5 Seconds.

An upgrade to Enhanced Jump. Press [Special 3] to pilot one of three vehicles: the X-Suit, V-Bomber, and U-Sub. Switch between them by holding [Shift] and pressing [Special 3]. The X-Suit is a powerful exosuit that increases functionality in most situations. The V-Bomber is a lightning-fast jet for agile combat in an atmosphere or the vacuum of space. The U-Sub is submarine with mining capabilities that withstands environmental damage.

An upgrade to Flash Jump. Cling to walls by moving against them during a jump, and refresh your jumps upon doing so. Press down to slide down while clinging. Jump while clinging or sliding to jump. Move away from the wall to get off.

An upgrade to Glide. Gain another three midair jumps and a wall jump. Midair jumps are 85% as effective. You cling to walls slightly longer than the normal Wall Jump and slide down slower as well. Glide energy cost decreases with higher Agility.

An upgrade to Knight's Bash. Cause Judgement while sprinting. Bash damage is doubled while wielding a Broadsword instead of a rasied Shield. When taking fatal damage, create a holy explosion and immediately regenerate all Health and Energy; gain 150% Speed for 2 seconds afterwards. Has a cooldown of 180 seconds. Explosion damage scales with Vigor.

An upgrade to Knight's Slam. Hold [Shift] and jump while grounded to shoot into the air. Doing so provides Invulnerability until you start to fall or hit the ground. Using this prevents you from double jumping in midair. Double-tap down while aerial to crash downwards towards your cursor, invulnerable while doing so. Upon landing, flame erupts from the ground, dealing more damage the longer you fell, and scaling with Strength.

An upgrade to Marksman: while Ideal Shot is active, Power Multiplier is increased by 150%, but movement is completely disabled. Getting hit prematurely breaks this effect without the normal reduction to cooldown. Must be on ground to activate.

An upgrade to Shadow Step. Blend into the darkness, stealing nearby Power and Armor from enemies before reappearing. Stolen Power and Armor steadily ticks down at 10% per second, and is never given back to enemies. Does 50% less damage than Shadow Step.

An upgrade to Shadow Step. Energy cost is decreased and the initial windup is removed, but Max Range is decreased to 10 Blocks. Dealing damage with this attack has a 10% chance to instantly kill enemies that aren’t facing you, percent chance increasing by 10% for every 10% Health the enemy is missing. Failing to deal damage with this attack instantly drains all Energy.

An upgrade to Soldier's Energize: while aerial, jump to dash upwards. Holding [Shift] while dashing causes the dash to traverse in the held direction: doing so consumes 30 Energy to leave behind three Shrapnel Grenades. The Shrapnel from these grenades always cause the Bleed status. Dash up to three times while aerial.
An upgrade to Spike Sphere, while transformed you regen slightly and are affected by low gravity. In addition, hold left click to create a barrier that pushes enemies away, draining energy to do so.
An upgrade to Spike Sphere, while transformed, ignore knockback and deal contact damage to enemies. Armor is also increased while transformed.

An upgrade to Spike Sphere: EMP Sphere moves quickly and can fire pulses that Overload and Stun enemies. Holding jump allows the sphere to magnetize towards nearby, opposite walls. Pressing [Shift] + [Special 1] regardless of transformation plants a Beacon that slowly regenerates Energy for nearby allies and speeds up wall magnetization. When beacons are within 20 blocks of each other, they chain electricity that deals damage based on Intelligence.

An upgrade to Sprint, while running, enemies receive damage and knockback. Damage is doubled when holding up a shield. Damage scales with Strength and Run Speed. Energy Cost decreases with higher Agility.

An upgrade to Wizard's Magic Shield: provides the same effect as Magic Shield, using up Energy to halve damage taken. However, while Elemental Overcharge is active, Element Resistances are maxed and Power Multiplier Increases up to +20% as Energy Decreases. Elemental Overcharge fires a bolt of pure Nova Energy in retaliation whenever you are damaged. Energy Regeneration is 75% as effective when compared to regular Magic Shield.

Announcement:
Rylasasin (who had previously contributed) has been added as a dev and will be maintaining this mod in the future, as the original author no longer has the time nor energy to do so.
For those familar with the 'Rylasasin Fork', those changes have been merged (with a notable exception.) For those not familiar, they will be listed below.
For the forseeable future, efforts will be spent on improving what is already here instead of adding new major things (like Specs.) We apologize to those that were looking forward to the Pilot/Theif/Etc specs,
but that simply will not happen in the forseeable future.

Finally, we must announce removal of GiC support. They wish for a Standalone experience, and we will respect that. Plus it will allow us to concentrate efforts on compatibility with other mods (Arcana, Maple32, Starforge, etc) and on things of greater priorities (such as upgrade chips).
We appreciate your understanding.
Mechanics:
    Mechanist can now be unlocked (faster) by killing Frackin, Shellguard, FFS/DaE, Arcana, and Maple32 robots. Defeating robot bosses from these mods vastly helps.
    Mechanist Fortify covers these too.
    Valkyrie can now use shortspears.
    Most Specializations no longer have stat requirements. They looked good on paper before skills were a thing, but no one likes them now so they're gone. Those that still have them are halved.
    Specializations are unlockable at level 25 instead of 35.
    Affinities can be upgraded at level 35 instead of 45.
Techs:
    Shadow Step: When used, a black puff of smoke hides your escape (purely visual/flavor, the smoke does nothing unlike with Escape! or Petal Dance)
Compatiblity:
    Swansong now drops XP
    Return to Earth bosses and monsters drop XP
    Arcana support
    Maple32 support
    Kitsunebn and Lucario Aura usable with all classes in classic (all races for now but will change in the future).
Chips:
    Six new weapon chips for specialization weapons. Two for Omniathrower, two for Orbital, and two for True Aegis
        Omniapressure increases Omniathrower range and knockback at the expense of effect duration.
        Omniapalm leaves sticky projectiles on surfaces and has increased after effects at the expense of direct damage.
        Nebula causes orbitals to phase through walls at the cost of range.
        High Orbit increases range and gives seeking to orbitals, at the expense of projectiles no longer bouncing/peircing.
        Great Wall, which increases shield health and removes perfect blocking requirement, while also removing perfect blocking.
        Parry This! a parry upgrade that gives more power and beam length for perfect blocks in exchange for demaning more precise perfect blocking.

April 1 - Nothing to report.

April 12 - I found Kevin in the break room today, rolling around on stolen cheese. We made eye contact. He seemed ashamed. He then moved over, and motioned that I should join him and explained by merely stating 'it's Tuesday'.
April 13 - Dereck was excited that Kevin had made him lunch today. When I explained the stolen cheese...he seemed somewhat less excited about his 'delicious cheese sandwich'
April 15 - Today it was like Kevin only just ever discovered what water did with paper. And he wouldn't shut up about how wonderfully soggy it felt.
April 18 - Kevin has wandered around for three days, screaming at the top of his lungs. When asked to stop, he tells us that 'my caps lock key is broken' and then gives us the finger.
April 19 - Today Kevin celebrated nudity day. This makes the total of 'times we didn't want to see Kevin nude' to 322.

April 2 - Kevin got air of our fossil restoration project, and wanted to join in. We gave him a Trilobite to clean off, and he did a good job at it (surprisingly). Unfortunately, we made the mistake of letting him choose the next fossil he wanted to prepare for showcasing on the exposition on the lower decks. We had to pry private Holix's grandmother - who came to visit - out of Kevin's hands.
April 25 - The medical bay was full of honey bees today. Kevin said he could help, and provided a briefcase. It held a rather large amount of yet more agitated bees.

April 26 - He now calls himself Dr.Bees. Non-stop. As if that wasn't annoying, he just burst into my office and said 'What's this? an office woefully unpopulated by bees? This briefcase full of BEES should take care of that!' and poured them into my office.

April 30 - Kevin came to the kitchen with a meal of cooked human hands, and fried faces today. Despite the morbid thoughts we had, and the salivating Floran crewmembers, we had to ask where he gotten these horrid recipes. He merely said he had an Alpaca friend somewhere, who was a hat enthusiast by the name of Carl.

April 9 - Kevin was urinating on one of the visiting Kirhos delegates, and got mad when we attempted to stop him. He claims that the man was stung by invisible jellyfish and he was merely attempting to help him ease his pain.

The radioactive bulbs within them are the sentient part of the being, a consciousness contained within. The plant-like outer body is their self, and it hardens over time until calcifying into mineral-hard 'flesh'. Eventually, generally after death, it becomes graphite. Their actual bodies sprout feather-like hair that is both supple and soft. It appears to be highly resistant to radiation (effectively nullifying it).
It is likely the case, then, that without these feathers the X'i would be virtually unable to socialize with the galactic community. Their very presence would make them a hazard to the health of every current intelligent civilization we know about. They pose next to no threat, thankfully, and are valuable members of any team they assist.

While they have issues communicating they are outgoing, personable and always ready to help others. Frankly, it's rare to find a group so collectively pleasant to be around. There's a reason for this, however...See, X'i have exceptionally open dietary needs. They can effectively eat whatever they want to sate their near-constant hunger. You will almost never meet a X'i who is not frequently snacking! Without food their cores begin to die down, and this leads to lethargy, weakness and (as is the case with every other race) eventually death. A side-effect of their constant eating is that a good many food types they enjoy (dirt, especially) possess narcotic-like effects on their moods not unlike heavy dopamines. With their pleasure-centers so easily stimulated, it is easy to see why they are pleasant companions.
Ultimately, the X'i are much closer to an organic-inorganic hybrid...a perfect mix of Silicon and Carbon-based life. A homonculus such as this is surely not a purely natural occurrence. I fail to see how in any natural circumstance this specific coincidence of genetics could occur.

Certain enemies may have an elemental shield that essentially makes them invulnerable. In order to properly damage these enemies, try to make sure your damage matches the shield's element type. Doing enough damage of the same element will strip the shield. Upon stripping a shield completely, the enemy in question will be vulnerable for a short period, so do your best damage then.

There are shields for every element, and the only true distinction is their color, so be aware and try to remember each one as you come across it. Although most elemental shields must be hit by the same element type to break, there are some elements that bypass this rule and deal ^red;half damage^reset; to certain shield types:

Nova Damage can break Fire, Electric, and Ice Shields.

Denoted by the BLOOD UI above them, these enemies are massive killers, targeting other enemies first in order to grow in size and heal. Normally rather tanky, these enemies will grow once their BLOOD Bar maximizes, gaining increased Power, Health, and Protection. While the BLOOD Bar is full, these enemies lose some of their Protection, meaning if you haven't yet, you should really try to finish them off: otherwise they will heal back to full Health and grow ever more powerful.

Denoted by the BREED UI above them, these enemies are normally passive until attacked. When attacked, their BREED Bar begins to count down, and when it finishes doing so, they will spawn a number of smaller monsters that will attack you. While their BREED Bar refills, they lose some Protection, making then the best time to deal damage. If swamped by many of their bred monsters, try to kill the BREED Mini-Boss quickly, as any monsters they created will die instantly without energy supplied to them from their parent.

Denoted by the BURST UI above them, these enemies are essentially immune to damage until their BURST Armor is broken. In order to break BURST Armor, weapons that deal great damage all at once must be used. For example, Hammers or Sniper Rifles are recommended, but Machine Pistols and Daggers are not.

Denoted by the RAPID UI above them, these enemies are essentially immune to damage until their RAPID Armor is broken. In order to break RAPID Armor, weapons that hit often must be used. For example, Machine Pistols or Daggers are recommended, but Sniper Rifles and Hammers are not.

He insists that our version of science is akin to (and I quote) 'making love to a dead sea lion in the air while on fire'. I am now attempting to picture exactly what this act would look like.

Feb 18 - Norbert finally snapped. He pushed Kevin off the roof after luring him upstairs for 'ninja practice', a thing which no Kevin can resist. We had assumed at long last that we had freed ourselves from his tyrannical pranking. We were sorely mistaken. It turns out he has gene-linked his mind to this facility. Any attempt at murder results in a clone being immediately spawned using his most recent brainscan. He claims 'the station made him do it'. He also apparently 'invented the question mark'.
Feb 2 - Someone switched all of the Smarties with Skittles.

Feb 21 - Kevin kept persistently saying that 'the bird is the word' today. This made the meeting of the engineering staff awkward, seeing as he just burst in. And Axiena, the fuel-expert of us, who is an Avian was there. Now, being a 'bird' wouldn't be so bad to ignore kevin's 'quirks' but she's also a mute. Being reminded that she couldn't 'be the word' at all (having no vocal capability since birth) was rather rude. Preparing a cake congratulating her on her muteness was worse.
Feb 24 - Kevin came back from a research expedition. He brought somebody named 'Greg' with him. Please kill me.
Feb 25 - Kevin has been missing for several days. Nobody knows where he is. Also, somebody has been eating my cheesecake. I'll ask the cooks to bring it to my office.
Feb 27 - I'm sure somebody is breaking into my personal office to do nothing else but eat my cheesecake. Sounds like something Kevin would do, but he's nowhere to be seen.

Feb 8 - After Kevin somehow got his hands on an ancient audiotrack of the old Earth music known as 'Darude; sandstorm', we weren't bothered at first. When he wouldn't let that damn song get a rest for several hours, even at night, we had to do something. We scheduled a trip to the most nearby desert biome with dangerous sandstorms tomorrow. Lets see if Kevin ever plays that Gods-forsaken song again after being sandblasted for an hour or two. We'll say it's a picnic.
Feb 9 - Yep. He kept playing the song. Louder. He then composed a version completely in reverse, played only with vomit sounds and a strange repeated word: 'Yolo'.

Frackin' Universe has introduced a new ^orange;Research System^reset; as of version 6.0.0 (October, 2020). 

This change completely revamps game progression from the ground up, letting users choose what they want to learn, and when, at their own pace. It also brings with it a slowed down early-game and a more trackable progression chain from mid-game and onward.
You will be required to interact directly with the ^orange;Research System^reset; to do this, however.

To access the ^orange;Research System^reset; menu, the following are options:

- Your ^orange;Personal Tricorder^reset;, via the ^green;Green Beaker^reset; icon. This is the most immediate method, and is available as soon as you start your ships computer.

- Via your ^orange;SAIL^reset; on your ship, in the ^green;MISC^reset; menu.

- Via the ^orange;Quickbar^reset;, if you use that mod. We highly recommend it.


^cyan;Read the Guide books in your ships storage^reset; for more detailed help about game mechanics and features.

NOTE: ^red;You should no longer have Frackin Races^reset; installed if using Frackin Universe. This will cause problems.

^orange;If using BYOS mode with custom races^reset;: you must install the addon located on Steam/CF Forums (FU BYOS Race Addon).
^orange;If using Custom Races with FU SAIL^reset;: Install theaddon via Steam or CF Forums (FU SAIL Modded Race Support).

You can open this window manually if you have the StardustLib or QuickBar mod installed via the !Updates button.
Please make sure you are not using anything included in the RED (and ideally the other colors too) on the Info tab below.

FrackinUniverse adds a large amount of armors (and foods) and enhances some older ones, allowing for a greater variety of playstyles. These can be very useful through gameplay and provide exceptionally useful benefits!

^yellow;Set Bonus Inheritance^reset;: As an important note, armors that are used to craft other armors can still be used to complete armor set bonuses for sets that were used in the crafting chain, so partially upgrading your set is still viable.

^orange;Stats^reset; : Vanilla players may notice there are more than they are used to, and even the ones they are used to have different ranges. FU presents a wider variety of armor classes to spice up your play, and does the same with food.

If you are more interested in damage, pick up Power Armor or Hyper Power Armor to trade defensive stats for offensive ones. Alternatively, pick up Tank or Hyper Tank sets to outlast your enemy. They come in melee OR ranged! Fighting not quite your thing? Pick up an Exploration oriented set, and be at home in your environment! You're guaranteed to locate a set that suits your playstyle somewhere out there!

^orange;Resistances^reset; : Many armors in FU come with inherent resistances. Many biome weather effects will simply stop affecting you once you hit an appropriate amount, and various enemy attacks will do less damage. Nifty, right? It gets better; upgrade your armor, and those resistances will increase!

^orange;Bonuses^reset; : Most are increases to your stats, plenty are conditional.
Any that say ^green;+value^reset; are typically additive increases. It can be a little confusing, however. As example: if it gives +^green;3^reset;% Crit Chance it increases your crit chance by a flat 3%, but if it says +^green;3^reset;% Energy Regen, that's 3% of your base. The easiest way to remember is to ask yourself...does it have a base of 0? If so, it likely is like Crit Chance! If a bonus says x^green;1.3^reset;, or ^green;More^reset;, that's a multiplier on the value you currently have. Have 1000% Damage somehow? 100% More (or 2x) would make it 2000%! Small note: Regen is usually per second.

Of course, some bonuses have hidden components we couldn't easily include, for tooltip space.
 Additionally, there are some other phrase uses to note. If a set bonus states that it grants immunity to ^green;ALL^reset; of a related effect, that typically means all biome weather ^orange;as well as^reset; specific status effects related to that element. For heat, that includes burning and even lava! For radiation, that includes rad-burn.
As a small side-note, some terms or symbols are used loosely. If you see a bonus with x/y, that means the bonuses are different based on how their conditions are met. For weapons, this means how many of that type. If you see something like (Machine) Pistols, that means the bonus applies to Machine Pistols OR Pistols. This is typically done for tooltip space.

^cyan;Mining Sets^reset; :
 Mining laser sets grant a lot more mining laser damage...but that bonus is reduced significantly if you are pairing them with something else. Using a mining laser with a pistol, as example: 2x Mining Laser Damage becomes 1.25x.
^orange;Colors^reset;: Colors are important in identifying and understanding bonuses. To start with, set bonuses are identified by a ^yellow;^reset;, while a ^green;^reset; is only visible in crafting interfaces to display resistances. If a bonus stat is ^green;GREEN^reset;, that means it is a good thing. ^red;RED^reset; means it is a bad thing. ^cyan;Cyan^reset; is for bonuses that are binary. They typically do not stack with similar effects. This will be especially apparent with various foods...so choose carefully. It is worth noticing that there is ONE exception to the rules regarding colors: Glow. If you see Glow in a color, that is usually the color of the glow effect.

^orange;Special Bonuses^reset; : Some sets have special bonuses that don't really display much information due to lack of space, an unfortunate limitation of the game. Here, some bonuses will be explained.

^cyan;Adaptive Armor^reset;: Multiplies the wearer's total defense based on current health percentage, scaling between the left value at 20% health and the right value at 100% health.

^cyan;Auto-Medic^reset;: More complicated than ordinary regeneration, this effect will restore more health per second at the cost of an equal percentage of energy. It will also decrease energy regen and increase energy regen lock-out multiplicatively at 2x the heal percent.

^cyan;Thorns^reset;: a nova of thorns when hit, ^cyan;Fire Burst^reset; makes a nova of fire instead.

^cyan;Summons Minions^reset;: summons short-lived allies to fight alongside you or distract enemies. These minions scale based on the lowest armor's tier, so upgrading it is essential! Upgrade ALL of the pieces.

^cyan;Life/Energy Shell^reset;: Gain damage absorption (shell) which scales based on a resource (health, energy) to protect your health, comes with a matching overhead bar to indicate its state. Regenerates quickly if you haven't taken damage recently. ^cyan;Shell Immunities^reset; are granted only while the shell holds. The numbers on the effect's label indicate the conversion rate relative to the resource's stats. In order: capacity, regeneration rate, and the delay upon taking damage before it begins regenerating.

^cyan;Life Shell^reset; specific: Regeneration rate is a direct percentage of health per second, lockout is in specified seconds.

^cyan;Energy Shell^reset; specific: Regeneration rate is a percentage of the energy regeneration stat, base vanilla regeneration is 58.5% per second. Special note due to balance: Minimum lockout time of 0.5 seconds, and a maximum regen rate of 50% per second.

^cyan;Gravity Normalization^reset;: Personal gravity too low? Up it goes. Too high? Down instead. Exception: Zero-gravity.

^cyan;Vital Power^reset; and ^cyan;Juggernaut^reset;: these effects are set bonus exclusive, and quite powerful; they grant one stat based on a percent of another. Vital power grants power as life, Juggernaut grants life as power.

^cyan;Undying Resolve^reset;: increases Protection as your life gets lower, up to the stated amount, while ^cyan;Immortal Resolve^reset; grants HP Regen instead. If a set grants either, it will grant ^cyan;Immortal Resolve^reset; to your pet.

^cyan;Dark Commander^reset;/^cyan;Beast Master^reset;: Increases Damage, Protection, HP and Speed of your pets (both) and crew (Dark Commander) by the listed percent, increases their jump ability by half of that, and regenerates HP at a sixth of that amount per second.

^cyan;Capturenaut^reset;: Increases pet count by 1, plus an additional 1 per 2 tiers (up to +2) of the lowest equipped set piece. Grants an additional +1 if using alongside the back item. This means a fully upgraded set will allow up to 5 additional pets!

^red;Wretchel Toxicity^reset;: Ingesting Wretchel reduces core stats and healing received, and drains health over time. These effects increase in severity the more you consume in a short time frame, as well as while your health is critically low. It will ^red;KILL^reset; you, if you are careless.

^cyan;Charisma^reset;: Your ability to bargain with Traders at space stations. The higher your charisma, the better the deal (and fatter your bank balance!)



^cyan;Pet/Crew Stat Inheritance^reset;:
Overall scaling is as follows: HP, directly from your character, rather than just equipped armor. Protection: applied as a multiplier to HP via a specific formula. Damage: directly from character sheet. Health Regen: Inherits as a flat amount, except in special cases (^cyan;Immortal Resolve^reset;, effects not covered by FU, etc.). If you have 100 health and 10% HP Regen, it will grant your pet 10 HP per second. If a stat isn't here, a pet most likely does not inherit it.
^yellow;Special notes^reset;: Be mindful when taking powerful buffs like ^cyan;Glass Cannon^reset;, as it will reduce their health noticeably.

From the smoke, the Hunter emerged, blood spattered along her slender body. She picked up an arrow lodged in the ground, one that had sliced clean through her prey; of course, of course: she never missed... Her Bow hummed as it scanned the ammunition, a mist of liquid spraying from the bottom canister. These weren't normal arrows, and definitely not an average bow, but she was no ordinary predator.

Placing the now cleansed arrow in her quiver, she quickly searched for any other enemies as the smoke behind her dissipated, showing only red remains. She wasn't psychopathic, but rather ^red;efficient^reset;, and with each new target killed, her worries shrank. Her ears picked up a sound that only an animal would hear, and so she took off, deftly weaving through thickets of spiny branches. Despite her rapid movement, she barely made a sound as she approached what she could only assume was an enemy camp. Sure enough, she found a camp occupied by several soldiers.

She crouched: time to get to it. Drawing the string, a radiant magenta emanated from within her, spreading throughout the components of her bow and slowly enveloping her body. But before the light could shine bright enough to alert the guards of her presence, she released. The arrow flew true, landing dead center of the encampment, embedding within a wooden post before imploding. She smirked, brandishing her dagger and vanishing from sight.

Risen tells tales of how she fought in a war between stars and black holes, and how she helped drive the stars away to save the near-extinct black holes. We aren't quite sure, but we believe the stars may, in fact, be a reference to the Novakid. It wasn't so much what was said, but -how- it was said. If I recall, it was :

'The star-children of the First wanted to drive away the anti-children. We aided the anti-children. Their nebulas were safe, and through them came the Birthing'.

I once worked at MK Base, ..goddamn horrible memories in every possible way.

SECURITY! 
Time to escort this vermin off the premises!
I only seek to be left alone, I have no qualms with you personally.
I only wanted to play, but ended up in purrison somehow.

I opened the door. The room was empty, save for a single chair, upon which sat the doll. I picked the thing up, and with a surge of anger, threw it on the ground and stomped on it. The plastic shattered beneath my foot.

As I glanced up, a shadow passed across the wall, and the door behind me slammed shut. I fumbled, trying to get out, and as I finally did so, I caught sight of a figure disappearing around the corner up ahead.
I ought to focus on saving the ship. The ancient relics can wait a bit.
I oughtta move on before a meteor shower starts.

I don't think we're going back to Earth any time soon.
I owe her everything. She forged me into a warrior who never yields, and taught me to wield both mercy and ruthlessness.
I owe you my life!

I paid the big bucks for you!
Come on penguin, test your tin can!!
I partake in daily meals here. I don't eat anything else but Starry foods as of late...
I pass this power onto you, so that we may win.
I pay no attention whatever to anybody's praise or blame. I simply play my own music.
I peed a little over there.

I personally believe you're not that wondering MY story, are you?

I personally never really found myself fond of guns. Too inconvienent compared to just using magic.

I personally prefer sowing to sewing. 
...

I refuse to believe they could weed out all compassion in you...
I refuse to sit here or eat anything that comes off of this "table".
I refuse to sleep here. These crystals are poisonous.
I refuse to speak to a hedonist.
I refuse to speak to you.

I regret nothing!
I regret that I do not know more of your culture, though I would love to learn.
I remember buying drinks from machines like this... those were better days.
I remember fishing on Earth. I wonder how the fish are doing?
I remember hearing about people finding the Divern in the deep seas.

I remember seeing ancient ovens like this.
I remember seeing similar artifacts in Avian temples.
I remember some Grounded favored these strange lamps.
I remember spendin' the nights away in these long ago... I think.
I remember the old Earth precursors to these designs, always partnering with games and shows. Kind of crazy how many lined up for us when we finished the limited rollouts, we worked for weeks!
I remember the ruins in their game were of some advanced spiritual civilization, curious.
I remember these plushes being wildly popular after the game was released.
I remember you... I saw you when it all began.
I require minor repairs.
I respect you and your kind, Thaumoth.
I respect your use of magic, Arcanian.
I respect your values, bird-person. Your tombs will never be raided by me.
I respectfully disagree.
I restored my ability to form memories, but I can't restore what I lost.
I returned and my village was in shambles. There is no hope left here. May I join you?

I returned helplessly to my residence, only to find that it was already in shambles. Numerous precious documents I'd previously carried with me had been destroyed in the earlier arrest.

Crushed and angry, I pressed my anger to find the Greenfinger again in the hope that it would compensate me for the losses I had previously suffered as a result of its orders.

I returned to what was my residence, packed up everything that was still intact, and left unnoticed. I managed to catch the latest passenger spaceship to Zhushi Pond, where a merchant told me there would soon be a flight back to the Great Library.
I root for the Ancients.
I rule over and guide the ^green;Starry Cultists^reset; of this here planet.
I rule over and guide the ^green;Starry Cultists^reset; of this planet.
I said NO, bro! not cool!!
I said sheathe it!
I salute you, soldier.
I salute you.
I saw a massive sandstalker once. I was a coward and ran away...
I saw a real one back on Earth in a museum... another thing I miss about that planet.
I saw a rodent of unusual size the other day.
I saw a shaved Apex once. He looked like you. Sort of.
I saw a tentacle that was way too thick!
I saw blood spilt everywhere..

I saw everything going on with how some of the large picked on the small, the developers leaving, the controversies abound. I wanted to bring some light to the community, something new. So I tried to make something new, but familiar. I've had the idea for a long while, this idea became the mod known as Starburst. Which you are playing right now.

I saw how FU did the rework model and Betabound's vanilla+ model, and I decided to make a merger of the 2 ideas. Rework the game to change progression and give more variety, but keep it like vanilla as much as possible. No automation, no flashy weapons, keep the focus on the exploration. Just making what I thought the game needed to be better.
I saw soldiers way up in the embassy tower. I wonder why they're there?
I saw someone flying a shuttlecraft with a skull painted on it! Must have been either a cool person or a pirate. Or both!
I saw this chest way up on the tower. I wonder what's in it?

I saw what you did.

I scream, you scream, we all scream for-- oh, you get the point.

I see that you've found some seeds, great! Farming is a very useful skill for food and materials. You should plant them in some tilled soil, and water them until they grow. A ^orange;Foraging Table^white; should have the tools you need.

I see you have found some logs. Wood is a useful material used in almost everything. I suggest you kill additional trees and look in your crafting menu. Also remember to follow Protectorate Environmental Protection Guidelines.
I see you have made a Hazard Lab Table. This station will allow you to craft planet hazard blocking consumables, augments, EPPs, and even regulators. A must-have for any adventurer.
I see you have obtained a Planning Table. It will allow you to craft several more specialized crafting tables.
I see you have obtained a Workman's Table. It will allow you to craft several more specialized crafting tables.

I see you have your own mech! The Vanguard has produced a number of parts that should be compatible with it, and luckily for you, I have the blueprints for them. They're all yours, if you can ^green;find me a ^orange;Salvaged Nano Receptable ^white;while you're ^green;out in space^white;. I need one to repair my own mech...
I see you have your own ship too. Welcome, my fellow captain.

I see you're a fan of good weapons too!
I see you've acquired a music sheet! You can craft a radio at a ^orange;wooden tool table^reset; to listen to the music.

I see you've acquired some ammunition! Certain firearms gain a ^green;20%^reset; damage boost when using any type of ammo. If your ammo reserves are depleted or ^#71f2f6;SHIFT^reset; is held, the gun will instead use energy.
I see you've arrived at Dhakorin. The colony we lost contact with is just over the rise to the east.

I see you've found a core fragment. These strange hot crystals are used in explosives and guns, so I recommend getting a lot. They can also power some things.

I see you've made an inventor's table. This is a very important facility that will allow you to make other crafting stations. If you find something you can't do, I recommend using it to find solutions.
I see you, don't be shy... Would you think I'd be credible if I said, ^orange;Nothing bad would happen to you?^reset;

I've always wondered: why didn't we find any dead Ce'Tennan in Vas Vha'leih?
I've applied these potions to everyone with this perfume bottle. Is that fine, or should I get the needles?

I've become a different person... 
This is the new me. ^red;«^white;
I've been a warrior since I was a wee Alpaca.
I've been collecting different crystal types for my research. Want to see my hevika samples?

I've been commissioned by ^red;[REDACTED]^reset; to produce a weaponised vehicle built for Penguinkind. He showed me an example of what he wanted- a ruined rusted robot found on an abandoned planet.

I was intrigued; the old thing was crude in design and seemed to have been piloted with an animal brain. Terrible choice, who could possibly think that was a good idea? I accepted the task, fascinated with the origins of this junkyard automaton.
I've been deployed here to serve you, Agent. What shall we trade?
I've been developing a new strain with enhanced biosample production. Science is amazing!
I've been discovered by the Miniknog!

I've been drifting in space for quite some time, thanks to all these planets being unsuited for exploration. Despite all evidence to the contrary, my ship insists it has ran out of fuel and refuses to move from its orbit around this backwater planet.

This planet, obviously, is not what I was looking for, and scans indicate the indigenous species are nowhere near as cultured as myself, though that has been the case for the last four hundred and three planets.

I've been expecting you, Captain. Here, I will assemble that weapon for you... Just a little longer... There! A fully restored jumprifle! Be careful where you point that thing: it delivers quite the punch.
I've been experimenting with bion compounds in my home lab. The molecular structure is fascinating!
I've been experimenting with new drink recipes lately.
I've been given co-ordinates to a party. Maybe it's worth investigating.

I've been having issues with thieves intercepting my supplies... I managed to track the thieves to their hideout, but I can't go in there myself. Could you help me out? ^green;Take out their ^orange;leader^reset;, and I'll reward you with one of my latest ^orange;prototype weapons^reset;!
I've been hiding down here for a while, but I think I'm safe to climb back up now. ^green;Could you get me ^orange;ten climbing ropes ^green;so I can climb out of here?
I've been hunting since I was a ssprout and winning since I was a bud.
I've been inside the sewers beneath the town once. It's kinda scary in there.
I've been interested in ^orange;Ancient relics^white; for some time.. If you happen to come across one, can you bring back an ^green;Ancient Bust^white; for me?
I've been learning the ocarina! My neighbors wish I had a quieter instrument.
I've been living here for a few years, at least. I love it here!
I've been on that one ride ten times now. It's so good!
I've been patient enough, it's time to find another place to live.
I've been reading about the arknights. Their dedication to exploration is so inspiring!
I've been running around spraying everyone with this potion. Is that ok?
I've been seeing these everywhere lately. I guess they see me too.
I've been studying ceternia patterns lately. The way thoughts can shape energy is absolutely fascinating!
I've been studying gheatsyn crystallization patterns lately. So interesting!

I've been taken to a facility.
The pirates here are working with ex-USCM researchers.
I don't know what they hope to accomplish.
I've been tinkering with a custom plasma conduit design. If it works, it could improve efficiency by 15%!
I've been to so many conventions. They're always so fun!
I've been to the Starfarer's Refuge once. It was amazing.
I've been trained by the best! You have no chance against me!

englishText: I've been waiting years for this, Floran!
I've been working on this new theory, regarding displacement through walls. I wonder what Dr. Elliot will think of it.

I've come here after being released from a USCM prison and everyone has accepted me. I want to show them how much they mean to me. ^green;Bring me ^orange;5 units of gunpowder^green;, crafted at a ^orange;primitive furnace^reset;, so I can make ^orange;fireworks^green; and show you how to make them too!
I've dealt with Ancient ruins for my whole life, but none of them is as strange as this one.
I've dealt with Ancient ruins my whole life, but I've never regretted it.
I've decided I'm gonna be a loose cannon Law Enforcement! Watch out, crime-doers!
I've decided I'm gonna be a loose cannon Peacekeeper! Watch out, crime-doers!
I've decrypted the access to this teleporter for you. You can use it to teleport back to Nova Station before the decryption become invalid.
I've detected a door above is connected in this circuit. You'll have to go back around to reach it.
I've detected a nearby Akkimari drill. If you stay near it, I can capture it and let you reap the rewards.
I've detected only a small quantity of bandits located on this island, this should be a breeze for you.
I've done a mighty fine job on these. They won't letcha down.

I've done all I can here. The Floran living amidst the ruins appear to be unnaturally savage, even by Floran standards, but they aren't my main problem. There are things deeper in the temple, and eyes and ears aren't their only senses.

It's also getting harder to stay hidden. I had a close brush the other day while witnessing some kind of ritual.
I've done some things I'm not proud of, but I guess I haven't done enough if YOU are here.
I've ensured, that the materials used for my wares have been made under fair conditions.
I've faced monsters while exploring on my own, but you - Gosh, your stance is better than any teacher I've ever seen in Wilderness Self-defence courses!
I've faced worse than you or <questGiver>.

I've finalised my plans for one-man flight! ^green;If you aren't busy, please take this blueprint and craft me ^orange;paper wings^reset; ^green;at a ^orange;spinning wheel^reset; so I can soar like the moon in the night sky!
I've finally found Mr. Coock. I should return to Inky.

I've finished a ^orange;Tentacle Challenge Door^white;. 
I should talk to Inky.
I've found Leda Portia!
I've found another ^orange;Chocobo^reset; for you whenever you have the greens!
I've found gates in caves on some planets, similar in design to the structure outside. Do you think they're related?
I've found some pretty cool things while spelunking. Wanna take a look?
I've got BELLS of steel!
I've got a crush on Azurii, but don't tell her!
I've got a feeling. There's a tough nut up ahead.
I've got a home in the big city. You can actually see it from here.
I've got a lot of metal to shape.
I've got a message from my former caretaker today, it was very cheerful! I miss her a bit... But I know other altas need her more than I do.
I've got a pet Snugget back home. She's adorable, but the crew ain't permittin' me to t' take 'er with me.
I've got a stim with your name on it. I know, I found it weird too.
I've got all sortsa arms 'n armour.
I've got all the time in the world to do whatever I want now, I guess...
I've got an offer for ya - let me hide on your ship, and I'll brush for ya! There are people I need to avoid...
I've got arms and armour of all kinds.
I've got everything over there, let's go!
I've got good stuff, made all by myself.
I've got just the ride for you!
I've got just the tools for preparing defences against the Miniknog.
I've got my eyes on you, fluff.
I've got my supplies just over there.
I've got no idea what the point of this is. It's probably a human thing.

I've got one final challenge for you! I want you to ^green;find and destroy a ^orange;Ce'Tennan Oculus^reset;, and you'll earn yourself access to the best weapon attachments I have. ^green;I've heard the ancient drones can be found in highly peculiar space anomalies ^reset;- you'd better come prepared, as it'll put up a heck of a fight.
I've got packages going to three different systems today.
I've got plenty of good Gad'hur for sale here.
I've got plenty of good Gad'hur for sale.
I've got so much goo inside me... ^red;«^white;
I've got some cool viona stuff, sis!

I've got some more weapon attachments in store for you, if you can beat my next challenge. I want you to ^green;find and kill ^orange;5 Sandspitters^reset;, but it won't be easy! ^green;You can find the large worm-like beasts on desert worlds ^reset;- watch out for the sand they spit at you!
I've got some partying equipment, want to have a look?
I've got some techs if you are interested. Just don't take too long.
I've got something just for you!
I've got something that can help you. Stuff don't come free, though.
I've got stuff at my place that I, like, need to get rid of. Come with, and I'll sell it to ya!
I've got stuff for exchange!
I've got supplies if you need them, just make it quick.
I've got the best wares money can buy!
I've got the target in sight!
I've got to get moving. My ship is waiting!
I've got tonnes of military surplus equipment. You interested?
I've got what I came here for anyway.
I've got you in my sights!
I've got- *yaaawn* ...a real urge to sharpen my claws here.
I've gotten a ton of work done today, a skele-ton!
I've had a great idea! I want to add music to my act! I have this wonderful guitar but ^green;one of the strings is broken. ^orange;Find me some string ^green;and I'll reward you!
I've had a long chat with an Elunite before and I was left speechless. The concept of everyone being someone else's hosts is difficult to stomach.
I've had bananas before. They're... meh.
I've had enough of these motherf***ing snakes on this motherf***ing spaceship
I've had enough of these!
I've had enough of this place...
I've had enough of your crap, furball. I'm leaving.
I've had nightmares about your kind! But I'll be nice, I know it's not your fault.
I've heard a lot about the Neki, mostly terrible things.
I've heard a lot about your ancient kind. What does it feel like to harness the power gifted by the Cultivator?
I've heard a lot of good things about this show. Never watched it, though.
I've heard about a scientist who put his brain in a robot like this. Now he's paranoid and runs away from everything.
I've heard about a scientist, who put his brain in a robot. Now he's paranoid and runs away from everything.

I've heard about all about you, Protector. Welcome to ^orange;Lighthaven^reset;. I'm ^orange;Carmine^reset;, the captain of this outpost. I have an important matter to discuss with you - talk to me again when you're ready.
I've heard about the tragedy on Earth. I'm so sorry.
I've heard about you, <entityname>. Did you plan on reducing this place to ash, like others you visit?
I've heard bad things about dark purple stars.
I've heard enterash has purple skies! I really want to visit someday and see it myself.
I've heard good things and bad things about Angels...
I've heard good things... also bad things, but I really like those good things.
I've heard its pretty warm in its shell due to all the reflections.
I've heard lots about humans, lots of good things.
I've heard many Avians love Oranges, the seeds make them better apparently.
I've heard nobody knows how your kind works, kinda like Avolite.
I've heard of a cool fish called Imperviray that's coated in Impervium, I want to catch it someday.
I've heard of a floran known as ^#758468;Sedge^reset;. Seems he was also a menace on the world he was on before being taken down by an army led by some princess.
I've heard of a group called the "Cryophoenixes." They used to live near the dark stars.
I've heard of a sword in a stone, but this is... somehow even more wierd.
I've heard of bacon in pancakes, but pest? Eugh! ^orange;Type: Cooked Meat + Vegetables + Dairy + Eggs^reset;
I've heard of black holes, apparently they're ancient stars that grow beyond their bounds.
I've heard of larger measuring devices, but this is ridiculous.
I've heard of people going on voyages for one of these... the rares must have called to them.
I've heard of replacement bodies, but this is ridiculous!!
I've heard of the destruction of a great planet known as the Earth. The Ruin... a truly foul thing.
I've heard of these cultists, they're... not too fond of others. Hmm... Reminds me of...
I've heard of this Miniknog. They don't seem to treat your people nicely.
I've heard of this game before, heard something about foresight?
I've heard of you! You are <entityname>, right?
I've heard of you! You're ambassador <entityname>, right?
I've heard of your kind before - you are a Trink, no?
I've heard of your kind, quite the technological marvels.
I've heard of your struggle against the Theleans. I'm truly sorry.
I've heard rumors about a planet that looks like space itself. Ever heard of it before? It's a fascinating concept.

I've heard rumors of a certain ^darkmagenta;power found in Ancient Ruins ^white;from Esther. I'd like to get my hands on it for some experiments. ^green;Could you bring me say, ^orange;1000 units of this so called Ancient Essence^white;. Thanks in advance.

I've heard rumors of an elusive material known as ^orange;Ancient Essence^white;. If it turns out that this material exists, can I have 400 of it? I might be able to make an aimable dash upgrade with it.
I've heard rumors of the Miniknog trialling similar arcade machines in some mind control project.
I've heard rumors that the Terrene Protectorate was secretly supplying aid to the rebels. Now the rebellion is truly on its own...
I've heard rumors that these guys are actually just fellow Humans in costumes! That can't be right... Right?
I've heard rumors that your kind aren't as free as we perceive you to be. What say you?
I've heard rumour of beasts far beyond any the Floran have hunted.
I've heard rumours of a Trink with faulty wiring hanging out in a cave nearby. It's probably best to stay away.
I've heard some drinks made with this stuff can keep you cool for days.
I've heard some old rumors of a guy known as the ^pink;Ghost Digger^reset;. A rather mysterious figure, no?
I've heard stories about this character and her fuzzy companion travelling the universe together.
I've heard stories about this stuff...
I've heard tales of an assassin group of Helions lead by a devious Avian heretic.
I've heard tales of firefly civilizations in faraway lands.
I've heard tales of rabbit-eared folk, but have never met one.
I've heard tales of the Nightar, Do you really hate the sun?

I've heard that Hylotls on ^green;Eminsnows^reset; master a kind of blade arts called Tsukikage, one known for its accuracy, speed and vehemence. Maybe the environment forms such skill there can inspire me on my new tech. ^orange;Would you help me find something interesting?^reset;
I've heard that M-ASA is working with AEG-Corps on the blueprints for a new main dreadnought gun.

I've heard that ^orange;<target>^white; is terribly afraid of ^orange;<item>s^white;. If you ^green;threaten <target.pronoun.object> with one on my behalf,^white; I'm sure <target.pronoun.subject>'ll start taking me seriously. Can you do this for me?
I've heard that all of the most powerful altas are indeed named after flowers... Is this story true?!
I've heard that at some point this world was turned into a massive automated forge.
I've heard that some felids have a disdain for water, does your kind suffer the same aversion?
I've heard that some of these planets contain a tall ancient spire. It would be great to find one.
I've heard that some of you have exotic alloy claws... do YOU?
I've heard that some space trains were designed by this fella.
I've heard that stardust crippits are one of the unbroken keepers of the stardust asteroids, made by celestia to protect smaller stardust creatures in their early years...
I've heard that taking an arrow to your knee is painful. I've never understood pain.
I've heard that there are scavengers scrounging up what's left of Earth, I hope they didn't steal any of my belongings!
I've heard that these grow naturally in special geodes, and then researchers cut them out in proper shapes.
I've heard that this is momma Elin's own recipe. Very exciting!
I've heard that your kind are masterful with blades.
I've heard the Aegi have no religion. How sad.
I've heard the Ocean Surprise is tasty... only really from the Hylotl, though.
I've heard the Roc slayers of Solalei use bows and armors similar to what this addon can conjure.
I've heard the founder of this park is a millionaire.
I've heard the pride of the Glitch are in their weapons and heraldry.
I've heard the pride the Glitch have in their weapons and heraldry.
I've heard the ruins on ardent taiga planets tend to attract scavengers. I should be careful when I venture there.
I've heard the salve-maker chief is receiving new apprentices, if you are interested.
I've heard there were many wise humans, and many fools too. It is the same amongst the Hylotl.
I've heard this Faahri has quite the cold, yet understanding glare.
I've heard this book is often being read to newcomers to ^#b0e0fc;viona corfals^reset;, who weren't wary about viona's negative consequences.
I've heard this can be used as a substitute for cactus juice. The only problem is... What's a cactus?!
I've heard this one is made from crystal plants.
I've heard this story is about a real asta, who once met an actual time drifter, thinking it's a ray of light. Very lovely.
I've heard through tapped comms that they're helping the rebellion.
I've heard through tapped comms they're helping the rebellion.
I've heard what happened to your planet. I'm truly sorry.
I've heard worse from the Florans.
I've heard you can win prizes for the best picture taken in the park.
I've heard you produce silk. Are you some kind of spider?
I've heard you were invaded by the Thell as well. Is it true?
I've heard your food is wonderful. Can you sneak me some sometime?
I've heard your kind are mostly scavengers. Don't try anything here.
I've heard your kind can be quite hostile to strangers.
I've heard your kind eats Florans. I already like you!
I've heard your kind have short tempers. I'm not looking for trouble.
I've heard your kind like to eat sentient aliens. I disapprove.
I've heard your kind likes mysteries. You should investigate the Old Ones.
I've heard your kind produce silk. Can I have some?
I've heard your people are extremely capable engineers.
I've issued a request for admission as a Fleet Captain. I can't wait for the Council's response!
I've joined an eldritch cult recently. I hope you are okay with it.

I've learned much more than that, as well.
Because the Cultivator is gone, our Holy Power is ^green;slowly but surely running out^reset;. We used to live forever alongside the Cultivator ^gray;(apparently, I wasn't there)^reset; but now we only are expected to live a ^green;mere 10,000 years^reset;! That's very low. I do not know what happens to us when we truly die.
I hope that we join the Cultivator once again in death, ^green;wherever It may be^reset;.
I've left the Nomada behind!

I've lived a long life, surrounding by chaos, and yet, I don't feel as if it was particularly troublesome. Perhaps I've found my inner peace?

I see the vast souls of long-forgotten entities float through planets in dangerous systems, as if a reminder that, while dead, they are still... there. Waiting. Watching. But even so, a soul is a soul, an interesting concept - a remnant of life fluttering by - and everyone has one: you just need to open your eyes to see it. And once you do, and make peace with what was once cruel and selfish, each soul will choose not to haunt you, but to embrace you, and you will be enlightened.

And when you finally reach that peak, come and join me, because I am the only one up here, and I have been for quite some time.
I've lost my appetite.
I've m-met some of the other visitors that come here.. Such as ^yellow;S-Silver^reset;, the historian.. She's very nice. I-I like her!
I've managed to adapt to the heat. What about you?
I've met a Shoggoth like you once. They kept muttering somethin' about "death state". What's that supposed to mean?
I've met many strange creatures, but you top them all.
I've never actually realised how goofy Petricubs look... mainly because I'm always busy being pestered.
I've never been a big fan of coffee. At least... I don't think I have?
I've never been as big of a fan of Veronas hoverbikes as the Aegi.
I've never been so happy! I found my perfect mate today!
I've never been to Empyrean planets before. How is it out there?
I've never been to a withered planet personally, however from what I've heard the repurcussions of setting foot on one without proper protection are rather severe.
I've never been to an arc before. What's it like?
I've never been to enterash, but I hear the ionic storms there are even more intense than here!
I've never enjoyed using swords. Give me a spear, and I'm happy.
I've never felt anything so soft before!
I've never felt so safe near a poison crystal before.
I've never had pleasure this overwhelming before~!
I've never had sex with a mortal before..
I've never heard of her, was she as despicable as the stories say?
I've never heard of this organization, I wonder where I could get more information about them.
I've never liked the way Avikan clothing feels.

I've never met such a strange soft-skin before.

I've never seen a clothesline like this before. It's certainly interesting.

I've never seen a jar this angry.
I've never seen a manner of plant like this.
I've never seen a plant walk on its own before.
I've never seen a trap like this from fellow Avians.
I've never seen a wooden refrigerator...
I've never seen an enclosure for snails before.
I've never seen an enternia ^#b0e0fc;niaton^reset; before, but I guess this is it. Seems to be much heavier than usual, but I guess this is because of materials.
I've never seen anyone like this guy. Not the most social race, probably.
I've never seen anything like it!
I've never seen anything like it. Oh, but it's so cute! And who could say no to those eyes?
I've never seen anything like this in my life!
I've never seen augments like these, they seem more advanced... and kinda cobbled together.
I've never seen one of your kind before - what are you, glorious machine?
I've never seen so much hair on a single creature.

I've never seen this kind of sea cucumber.
I've never seen your kind before.
I've never traded anything unsanctioned, I swear!
I've never tried sleeping in a tree before, new things I suppose.
I've not seen a lone Woof nowadays.

I've noticed you seem to have an odd ability- you can repeatedly obtain massive supplies from these simulations, along with a whole lot of injuries, of course...
I've only heard so much about the undead, but they seem rather nice.
I've read Nana's cooking guide recently, might try making something from nia cuisine soon.
I've read every single book in this cabinet. Several times.
I've read many wonderful ones in the Grand Pagoda Library, although my favorites would be the diaries of Hiraki Corale.
I've read several books by human authors, all very impressive. You are an eloquent race.
I've read that astral narfins are the most shy narfin subspecies, and are a pretty rare find as it is. Not only that, they look quite similar to common narfins, making them even harder to spot.
I've received your S.A.I.L's message, partner. Come back if you're sure the camp is cleared.
I've received your signals. What's the matter?
I've run out of watercolors. I wonder if mixing water with scale dust would work.
I've rused you!
I've secretly always wanted to eat one of these.
I've seen Akkimari climbing these before. Perhaps these sheets act as ladders to them?
I've seen Capricoats that look cuter than you do, honest!

Can you ^green;pass this ^orange;note^green; to ^orange;<target>^white;? There's something <target.pronoun.subject> needs to know about <other>...
I've seen a Cacochius on a moon once. Looked really familiar.
I've seen a few of your kind around while exploring cold planets lately.
I've seen a human hatchling once. It was... odd.
I've seen better lookin' metal doors.
I've seen better workin' conditions in a snake pit. Can ya fix this soon?
I've seen better-looking gates.

I've seen far too many skulls already...
I've seen few creatures with feathers. Birds are scarce on Kadavan.
I've seen nothing of human culture, it saddens me that I might now never have the chance.

I've seen people going to extreme lengths, faking things so that they wouldn't be caught lying. But Takeo wasn't the type. He was always honest about what he saw in India. Brutaly so. Having some off-time, I figured I might as well meet new people in my life, so I pursued the leads. I wasn't expecting much. But what I got was more than what I could ever imagine.
I've seen some of the compounds discussed in this having a closer look taken at then in some popular alta studies, like ^#b0e0fc;CNOB^reset; and ^#b0e0fc;ECOC-FIOC^reset;.
I've seen some weird people here. I was kinda freaked out.
I've seen stars in the sky that have the mark of a bad omen.
I've seen the Miniknog field some of these.
I've seen the kind of diseases that the MiniKnog researches. Nasty stuff.
I've seen the miniknog use some of these, and to devestating effect.
I've seen these around ground-farts.
I've seen this symbol a lot.
I've seen war. Nothing good can come of it.
I've seen what the Miniknog does to rebels. Such cruelty.
I've set up a teleporter here. It's connected with your teleporter network, so you can come back here any time as you want.
I've set up a teleporter not far ahead that connected with your teleporter network, so you can come back here any time as you want.
I've sold stims to Big Ape himself.
I've stumbled upon some raw materials you might want.
I've taken up fishing lately, it's good for passing time.
I've totes got the best deals on these, uh... things. Wanna, like, buy some?

I've worked with the Protectorate for a little while, their weaponry can't be too hard to replicate.
I've yet to go outside for break. It's creepy out there.
I've yet to see it myself, but judging how specific the conditions are, I think I'm better off traveling to an ^#60c0fc;arknight^reset; station for that.

The news had just spread amongst my fellow Angels---the Cultivator fought the Ruin and sacrificed Itself---splitting into near infinite, wild pieces. There was panic, anger, regret..

^green;But I knew what I had to do during all that chaos^reset;.
I, for one, welcome our Miniknog overlords.

By studying some X'i cores that managed to survive the event in recently abandoned ghost towns, I found plenty of small holes that, when scanned, showed a map of unnerving tunnels. Small objects laid within, perhaps eggs, but evaporated when samples were attempted.
I, too, love dangling from sticks.
I, too, need to STORE my stuff.
I, uh, didn't expect such a vibrant green glow.
I, uh... H-hello?
I, uh... I'm at a loss for words.
I, um...

I- I didn't' even know i could get pregnant~
I-C Tea. A rather eye-opening beverage.
I-I hope i'm not t-too heavy.

In addition to stats normally present in Starbound, FU adds a host of its own as well. Some may be character stats, some may be weapon stats. Some may be both! They are detailed within this guide for easy access later.

^green;Charisma^white; - When shopping on FU space stations, Charisma helps you to make a profit by influencing ^cyan;Selling and Buying^reset; values. A high charisma means a high income ratio! Note that this only applies on Space Station trades and their related Kiosks for the time being. As a special note, every 33% charisma will allow you to bring an additional crewmember with you in the field. Be warned, penalties to charisma can have the opposite effect!

^green;Stun Chance^white; - With blunt weapons, each hit has a chance to stun enemies. Likewise with successful shieldbashes. This stat influences the chance that this stun will occur. This also can occur with daggers, rapiers, and a few other weapons.

^green;Shieldbash Chance^white; - When blocking with your shield, you have a chance to shieldbash. This stat influences the chances that the bash succeeds.

^green;Shieldbash Push^white; - How far a shieldbash will push an enemy, and how much damage it will inflict when successful.

^green;Projectile Count^white; - Typically only seen as a stat on weapons, it is indicated in most gun tooltips by 3 diagonally aligned bullets. This indicates how many projectiles are fired at once.

^green;Burst Count^white; - Exclusively on weapons. Indicated in the tooltip by a spread of 4 small bullets. These weapons fire a burst of projectiles in sequence.

^green;Tech Bonus^white; - There are various types of Tech Bonus. These will be listed when relevant. Any such bonus will influence techs. For example 'Jump Tech +25%' increase the efficiency of any Jump related techs by that amount.

^green;Weapon Mastery^white; - Occasionally you'll find gear that can grant 'Weapon Mastery' at different levels. Weapon Mastery provides additional benefits to particular weapons.

^green;Crit Chance^white; - The likelihood that you will score a successful critical attack with your weapon. Note that this can be a stat on both you -and- on a weapon. They will combine.

^green;Crit Damage Bonus^white; - The total bonus applied, in percentage, to critical damage strikes.

^green;Leech^white; - A form of healing that is unaffected by normal healing modifiers. This healing is divided over a duration (10 seconds at base); +10% leech means you will heal up to 1% of your health per second for 10 seconds per instance.

^green;Maximum Leech^white; - The maximum amount of healing you can have at a time, from leech. The default is 10%; from all leech instances you will not be able to heal more than 10% of your health per second.

^#e43774;Madness^white; - A measurement of your current sanity. The higher the value, the crazier you are. More than 50 effects can occur from madness, and not all are bad. You can spend Madness in the ^#e43774;Metaphysics Research Tree^reset;.

It wasn't supposed to be like this. It never was. But even so, it seemed, a miniscule, primal segment of her conscience had known all along. Her thoughts flickered to Soliste. Perhaps it was better this way.

She stared. Nothing stared back. It was strange, this 'nothingness', because 'nothingness' didn't exist: it couldn't, because even nothing was something. How ridiculous...

She listened as the words Egoen spoke reflected in the spaces between. She reciprocated, pointlessly, slowly edging her fingertips around the kunai strapped to her thigh. She knew he would not choose to depart, clutching on to life fruitlessly, spitting words of power at the emptiness surrounding: cursing this reality for snatching Zia from his grasp. So she would choose for him. There was no blood: there could not be; even so, he 'died'. Glad, at first, her emotions turned sour: without a doubt, this was the only way. She knew it as such; the nothingness told her - not through whispers, not through images, not through thoughts, but through reality. The endless-featureless-emptiness was existence: the only definite, the only absolute, the only truth. Despite this, she could not help but feel overwhelmed as his soul escaped and only hers remained: ensnared, forever. The moment was gone: he had taken it from her, not via his own actions, but by hers. She panicked, as there was nearly nothing left for her to do.

Soliste, she cried. Soliste! Was she waiting? Would she ever know? The nothing encroached and squeezed tightly, despite pulling her apart. Soliste: that was all she could think about, 'laughing' incredulously until there was nothing left to think.

And just like that, she was nothing too.

While ITDs are capable of moving all items by default, you will need special token items to filter for currencies or items the ITD does not recognize.
